cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Lost in the Process
cards.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring me the birthday invitations. I'll decide how we correct this failure in address verification.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wrote our old address on every one. Shouldn't you rewrite them?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can start replacement envelopes while I examine why the archive supplied an outdated location.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're the archive. There's nobody else to examine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I rule this a staffing failure across storage, checking and dispatch. You'll be the second checker. Put one corrected envelope in front of me; we'll repair the process before anyone writes a personal apology.

reason: Make A redirect B proposed personal remedy into assigned work and a staffing decision, using B sole-person correction to create procedural stages and a second checker rather than admit individual fault.
